::: lede
I work on pharmacogenomics, structural biology and implementation science for non-communicable diseases, and I write about how health research is produced, governed and taught in Zambia.
:::

I am a Lecturer in the Basic Sciences Department at the Michael Chilufya Sata School of Medicine, Copperbelt University, Ndola, where I have taught since 2019 and coordinate undergraduate research. My doctorate in Pharmaceutical Sciences is from Hokkaido University, Japan. This site collects my essays, the projects I am currently leading, and my publications.
